caption: The drawing depicts the interior wall of a room featuring a symmetrical decorative scheme. The composition includes a central dark brown wooden door set in a rectangular frame. The wall is predominantly off-white or cream, with architectural elements outlined in blue and red. On either side of the door, there are two large arched sections with blue stonework details around the arches. Above the door and along the upper portions of the wall are decorative red and blue floral patterns, including vases with flowers and stylized floral motifs. Flanking the door are two panels, each with a large central red flame-like motif and an area below filled with swirling red patterns. The lower section of the wall is decorated with repeating red flower patterns and slender green stems. The floor consists of reddish-brown tiles set in a diagonal pattern, and the ceiling above is made of wooden beams with a red border running along the upper edge of the wall. In the lower right corner, there is an inscription with names written in cursive.
title: Restoration Drawing: Wall Painting; Door
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
